first_divergence: The same EDIT assignment changes count (30 vs 2); that same update's stable descending sort moves the target from rank 2 to rank 15.
remove_targeting_note: This repository locates REMOVE and AGREE targets by rule-text substring, not the emitted number. EDIT targets an index. Renumbering alone therefore does not retarget an already-recorded REMOVE.

removal_resistance.assumption: Repeated REMOVE targets the same unchanged text; no other updates.
